t: MaxKare Treadmills - Treadmill Reviews & User Guide
s: As far as we can tell, MaxKare doesn't design fitness equipment, describing itself as an e-commerce company that sells via Amazon in the US and Canada. In addition to treadmills, they sell rowing machines, exercise bikes, mostly for under $500 (some well under), so they cater very much for the budget end of the market. They also sell products for the home including electric blankets, kitchenware and even baby care - quite a mixed bag. One thing to note if buying one of their fitness machines - while they offer a 30-day money-back guarantee, it's difficult to find any information about an actual warranty.
